cohort: 484 postpartum women admitted to two public hospitals in Harari Regional State, Eastern Ethiopia
finding: Nearly one-third of postpartum women developed anemia within 48 hours of birth, with risk factors including low education, inadequate antenatal care, cesarean delivery, blood loss, low pre-delivery hemoglobin, and lack of iron-folate supplementation.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of immediate postpartum anemia.
